description: Paid x402 tool. Assess the completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, and freshness of a master-data record or supplied attributes. Returns explainable issues, severity, affected fields, policy rules, and safe remediation guidance without changing data. Price ID: price.quality.v1.

entityType.description: One of the v1 entity domains. customer, asset, and person are closed Operator decisions, not gaps; reference data is served by get_reference_data.

qualityDimension.description: The quality dimensions the serving snapshot scores. Exactly the five the snapshot's quality object carries and the quality_rules registry may name.

inputSchema.description: Input for the paid quality assessment of ONE stored golden record or ONE submitted attribute set. Mirrors POST /v1/master-data/data-quality/assess. Exactly one of record_id or attributes is supplied, per BUILD.md 8.8; the semantics are implemented in crates/core/src/operations/quality.rs. Submitted attributes are assessed without being written, and only their digest is ever echoed back.

attributes.description: Candidate attributes to assess without writing them. Supply this or record_id, never both. No value submitted here is stored, published, or echoed: the answer names the input by its digest alone.

dimensions.description: The quality dimensions to assess. A registered rule scoring a dimension not asked for is absent from the answer's issues, passed_rules, and not_evaluated_rules alike.

include_remediation_guidance.description: Whether each reported issue carries remediation guidance.

record_id.description: Existing golden-record ID to assess. Supply this or attributes, never both.

inputSchema.title: assess_master_data_quality tool input

name: assess_master_data_quality
title: Assess Master Data Quality
